about_short_description.short_description: Corgea is a network management software that monitors data traffic and secures sensitive data for businesses.

product.name: Corgea AppSec Platform
product.description: An AI-powered application security platform that performs static application security testing (SAST), software composition analysis (SCA), secrets scanning, malware scanning, PII/PHI scanning, and auto-triage to detect and fix vulnerabilities in code.

product.name: Policy Playground and Policy Optimizer
product.description: An AI-enhanced environment for creating, testing, and optimizing security policies using natural language and YAML, enabling precise vulnerability detection and false positive reduction.

product.name: Corgea GitHub App
product.description: A GitHub integration that automatically scans pull requests for vulnerabilities and suggests fixes, streamlining secure code review and remediation.

identifier.value: Integration with Fortify and Other SAST Tools

product.name: Integration with Fortify and Other SAST Tools
product.description: Integration capabilities that connect Corgea’s AI-driven security analysis and remediation with established SAST tools like Fortify, Snyk, Checkmarx, Semgrep, and CodeQL.

product.name: Advanced False Positive Detection
product.description: An AI-driven feature that reduces false positives in static code analysis by understanding code context, framework specifics, and usage patterns.
